catalyst: Q3 2026 results released pre-market Mon Nov 9 (8:30 ET call), first print as the first primary listing on TXSE after the voluntary Nasdaq transfer; the retrieved sources carry the release date but not the reported figures

Q3 2026 (Nov 4): EPS -$0.81 vs -$1.02 est, revenue $25.7M, Lumvoa net product revenue $24.7M with 100+ patients on therapy; today's pre-market move driven by positive VRDN-008 Phase 1 data (Nov 9) - 74% peak IgG reduction, 15-18 day half-life, potential every-8-week dosing, MG registrational start planned mid-2027

QUILT-2.005 Cohort A topline (Nov 9): ANKTIVA plus BCG met the primary endpoint in BCG-naive high-grade non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (n=370), statistically significant vs BCG alone in CIS, no treatment-related deaths; Q3 earnings due Nov 10

Reformation Q3 FY2026 (Nov 5): revenue $173.6M +19.1% vs $169.7M consensus, adjusted EBITDA +64.2% to a 13.3% margin, EPS -$0.02 vs +$0.11 consensus on a 165.9% effective tax rate, FY26 revenue guidance raised to $610-612M; BTIG target raised to $21, Baird to $20

Fiscal Q2 2026 results (Nov 9, 8:00 ET): IMVT-1402 600mg met the primary endpoint - ACR20 at Week 28 of 92.5% vs 75.6% placebo (p=0.0139) in difficult-to-treat rheumatoid arthritis, ACR50 80.0% vs 56.1%; the 300mg arm was not differentiated, IMVT-1402 is not being advanced in Sjogren's disease, cash $722.3M
